units.en: He says I have been hoarding arms and armor. Aside from what the court has granted me, if there is even one such item it would count as private hoarding."
units.literal: He said that I store arms and armor; apart from official grants, if there is one such matter it is also private hoarding."

units.zh: 使者搜索其家，惟衣一笥，軍籍糧簿而已，乃寬之。
units.en: The envoy searched his home and found only a single chest of clothes and his military registers and grain accounts. He was then released.
units.literal: The envoy searched his home and found only one chest of clothing and military registers and grain ledgers—nothing more—and therefore released him.

units.zh: 景思曰：「使但械系送我入京。」
units.en: Jinsi said: "Put me in chains and send me to the capital—that is enough."
units.literal: Jinsi said: "Your envoy need only put me in fetters and send me to the capital."

units.zh: 先是，景思別有紀綱王知權者，在京，聞景思被誣，乃見史宏肇曰：「唐景思赤心為國，某服事三十年，孝於父母，義於朋友，被此誣罔，何以伸陳。
units.en: Earlier Jinsi had a steward named Wang Zhiquan in the capital. When he heard that Jinsi had been falsely accused, he went to Shi Hongzhao and said: "Tang Jinsi has served the state with a loyal heart. I have served him for thirty years and know him to be filial to his parents and faithful to his friends. How can he answer such a false charge?
units.literal: Earlier, Jinsi had another steward, Wang Zhiquan, in the capital; hearing that Jinsi had been slandered, he went to see Shi Hongzhao and said: "Tang Jinsi is wholeheartedly loyal to the state; I have served him thirty years—filial to parents, righteous toward friends—and through this false charge, how may this be set forth?

units.zh: 某請先下獄，願公追劾景思，免至冤橫。」
units.en: I ask to be imprisoned first. I beg you to investigate Jinsi thoroughly so that he may not suffer wrongful destruction."
units.literal: I ask to enter prison first; I beg that Your Lordship pursue and investigate Jinsi, lest he suffer wrongful ruin."

units.zh: 宏肇湣之，令在獄，日與酒食。
units.en: Hongzhao took pity on him and had him held in prison, sending him wine and food each day.
units.literal: Hongzhao pitied him and had him kept in prison, giving him wine and food each day.

units.zh: 景思既桎梏就路，潁、亳之人隨至京師，眾保證之。
units.en: When Jinsi was shackled and sent on his way, people from Ying and Bo followed him all the way to the capital, and many came forward to vouch for his character.
units.literal: Once Jinsi was shackled and on the road, people of Ying and Bo followed him to the capital, and the multitude vouched for him.

units.zh: 宏肇乃令鞫告事者，具伏誣陷，即斬之，遂奏釋景思。
units.en: Hongzhao then had the accuser interrogated. The man confessed fully to the false charge and was beheaded on the spot. Hongzhao then memorialized for Jinsi's release.
units.literal: Hongzhao then ordered the accuser interrogated; he fully confessed to false accusation and was at once beheaded; he then memorialized to release Jinsi.

units.zh: 顯德初，河東劉崇帥眾來寇，世宗親總六師以禦之。
units.en: Early in the Xiande period Liu Chong of Hedong invaded with his army. Shizong personally took command of the six armies to meet him.
units.literal: At the beginning of Xiande, Liu Chong of Hedong led troops to raid; Shizong personally commanded the six armies to resist him.

units.zh: 及陣於高平，景思於世宗馬前距踴數四，且曰：「願賜臣堅甲一聯，以觀臣之效用。」
units.en: When the armies drew up at Gaoping, Jinsi leaped and stamped four times before Shizong's horse and said: "I beg Your Majesty to grant me a full suit of stout armor, that I may prove my worth in battle."
units.literal: When they formed battle lines at Gaoping, Jinsi leaped and stamped four times before Shizong's horse and said: "I beg that Your Majesty grant me a full suit of stout armor, that I may show my usefulness."

units.zh: 世宗由是知其名，因以高平陣所得降軍數千人，署為效順指揮，命景思董之，使於淮上。
units.en: Shizong thereby learned his name. He took several thousand enemy soldiers who had surrendered at Gaoping, organized them as the Submission command, placed Jinsi in charge of them, and sent him to the Huai frontier.
units.literal: Shizong thereby came to know his name; he therefore took several thousand surrendered troops obtained at the Gaoping battle line, appointed them the Xiaoshun command, ordered Jinsi to supervise them, and sent him to the Huai region.

units.zh: 三年春，世宗親征淮甸，景思繼有戰功，乃命遙領饒州刺史。
units.en: In the spring of the third year Shizong personally campaigned in the Huai region. Jinsi won repeated victories in battle and was given Rao Prefecture in absentia.
units.literal: In the spring of the third year Shizong personally campaigned in the Huai region; Jinsi continued to win battle merit and was then ordered to hold Rao Prefecture prefect in absentia.

units.zh: 未幾，改授濠州行刺史，令帥眾攻圍濠州。
units.en: Before long he was made acting prefect of Hao Prefecture and ordered to lead troops in the siege of that city.
units.literal: Before long he was changed to acting prefect of Hao Prefecture and ordered to lead troops to attack and besiege Hao Prefecture.

units.zh: 四年冬，因力戰，為賊鋒所傷，數日而卒。
units.en: In the winter of the fourth year he was wounded by the enemy vanguard in fierce fighting and died several days later.
units.literal: In the winter of the fourth year, because of fierce fighting he was wounded by the enemy vanguard and died several days later.

units.zh: 世宗甚憫之，詔贈武清軍節度使。
units.en: Shizong mourned him deeply and posthumously made him military governor of the Wuqing army.
units.literal: Shizong deeply pitied him and decreed him posthumous military governor of the Wuqing army.

units.zh: 史臣曰：自古為人臣者，望重則必危，功崇則難保，自非賢者，疇能免之。
units.en: The historian remarks: From antiquity, ministers whose prestige grows great have inevitably faced danger, and those whose merit rises high have found it hard to preserve themselves. Only the truly worthy could escape such a fate.
units.literal: The historian remarks: From antiquity, for those who serve as ministers, when their prestige is heavy they are necessarily in peril, and when their merit is lofty they are hard to preserve—unless they are worthy men, who can escape this?

units.zh: 況王鄴帥昧明哲之規，周太祖乃雄猜之主，欲無及禍，其可得乎！
units.en: How much less could Wang Yin, commander at Ye, who lacked the wisdom to see danger clearly, hope to escape harm under Zhou Taizu, a ruler both formidable and suspicious!
units.literal: How much more when Commander Wang of Ye lacked the rules of clear wisdom, and Zhou Taizu was a lord both heroic and suspicious—could he have wished to escape disaster?

units.zh: 自福進而下，皆將帥之英也，擁旌作翰，諒亦宜然。
units.en: From Fujin downward, all were outstanding commanders. That they should bear imperial banners and serve as pillars of the realm was only fitting.
units.literal: From Fujin downward, all were heroes among generals and commanders; to bear banners and serve as frontier pillars was surely fitting for them as well.

units.zh: 惟彥超以捍寇而沒，可不謂忠乎！
units.en: Only Yanchao died while holding the enemy at bay—can this fail to be called loyalty!
units.literal: Only Yanchao perished while resisting bandits—can this fail to be called loyalty!
